memo.title: Sprint 12 Status
memo.summary: The team discussed the blocked auth module due to an unfinished API. John committed to fixing the API by April 7, and Priya's designs are ready but awaiting the API. A review meeting was planned for next Monday, and the release date was moved to April 10.
blockers: Auth module is blocked awaiting API fix
next_steps: John will fix the API by April 7
Alice will schedule a review meeting for next Monday with John and Priya

tasks.title: Fix the API
tasks.notes: The auth module is blocked until this is fixed

tasks.title: Update the release date to April 10
tasks.notes: The release is pushed to April 10

meetings.title: API Integration Review
meetings.purpose: Review the API fix and its integration with Priya's designs
meetings.agenda: Confirm API fix completion; Validate design integration; Identify any remaining issues

what_was_discussed: The authentication module development is currently blocked.
The blocker is an unfinished API that John is working on.
Priya's design work is complete but cannot be integrated until the API is ready.
The project release date was delayed to accommodate the fix.
what_was_decided: The official release date is pushed to April 10, 2026.
John committed to delivering the API fix by April 7, 2026.
A follow-up review meeting will be held to validate the fix and its integration with the designs.
what_to_follow_up: Confirm with John if the API fix is on track for the April 7 deadline.
Check with Alice if the 'API Integration Review' meeting has been scheduled with John and Priya.
Ensure the task 'Update the release date to April 10' has been assigned and completed.
open_questions: Is the API fix progressing as expected for the April 7 delivery?
What is the contingency plan if the API fix is delayed further?
Are there any other downstream tasks or team members blocked by this API issue?
risks_to_watch: The April 10 release date is critically dependent on the API fix being delivered on April 7. Any slip will cause another release delay.
Priya is currently idle, which impacts team velocity and resource utilization. We need to confirm if she can be assigned other tasks.
suggested_agenda: Status update on 'Fix the API' task from John.
Confirmation of 'API Integration Review' meeting schedule.
Discuss and define a risk mitigation plan for potential API fix delays.
Check Priya's availability for other tasks while she is blocked.
